name: Partners for Fish and Wildlife Program (competitive NOFO)
summary: Federal cooperative agreements for habitat restoration and protection on private and tribal lands in the United States, open to nonprofits, businesses, tribes and others who consult the local Partners office before applying. Listed as a project-lead cooperative agreement, not a payment to landowners for land use.

eligibility.rule: Project is located on private lands
Project aligns with regional strategic implementation plans or program priorities
Project generates no mitigation credits and uses no mitigation or in-lieu funds as cost share
No foreign travel, pre-award costs, unauthorized equipment or excessive indirect costs
Applicant is registered in SAM.gov before applying, except an individual applying as a natural person
Applicant and key project personnel are not prohibited, restricted, or excluded from awards

calls.label: FY26 notice of funding opportunity F26AS00068
calls.note: The page also says the program seeks projects year-round and applicants must consult their local Partners office first.

applicant_types.quote: Public and state institutions of higher education Private institutions of higher education Nonprofit Other Native American tribal organizations Nonprofits non-higher education with 501(c)(3) Nonprofits non-higher education without 501(c)(3) Miscellaneous Individuals Unrestricted Business For-profit organizations other than small businesses Small businesses

geography.quote: The PFW Program has approximately 220 staff working in all 50 states and territories.

access.quote: Go to www.grants.gov to apply, track application status, and subscribe to updates.

effort.quote: Applicants seeking technical or financial assistance from the Partners for Fish and Wildlife Program are required to contact local program staff BEFORE developing or submitting an application.
Informal award notice is given before recipients are invited to apply via Grant Solutions.
Electronically submitted applications from invited applicants must be submitted no later than 11:59 PM, ET, 09/30/2026.

eligibility.quote: To get funding, PFW projects must be on private lands.
Do not align with the regional strategic implementation plans or program priorities.
Generate compensatory mitigation credits under a Federal or state regulatory program or accept mitigation or in-lieu funds as non-Federal cost share for a project.
Include foreign travel, pre-award costs, purchase of unauthorized equipment, indirect costs in excess of the negotiated indirect cost rate or the de minimus indirect cost rate
Before applying, all applicants except individuals applying as a natural person must be registered in SAM.gov.
We are prohibited from making an award if a recipient or any key personnel are found ineligible, prohibited, restricted, or otherwise excluded from receiving or participating in an award

after_award.quote: Submit Federal Financial reports and Program Performance reports.
